case_punjab.summary: From 2022 to 2025, daytime detections in Punjab's October-November burning season fell 85% at the S-NPP VIIRS pass (about 13:10 local time) but only 66% at MODIS Aqua's pass, which has drifted to about 14:43. Burning appears to have moved later in the day, so counts tied to an early-afternoon pass (VIIRS, and the pre-drift MODIS that Calember reproduces) overstate the decline.

summary: Measured from the fire detections themselves, Aqua's median overpass moved from 13:33 (2003-2019) to 14:47 local solar time in 2025, and Terra's from 10:34 to 09:22. Fires are counted at different times of day, so the raw MODIS record drifts: in 2025 it recorded 92% of what pre-drift MODIS would have seen. Calember stays anchored to the pre-drift record.
